findingsAndLimits.manualProcedure: Hagen-Poiseuille Q=pi*delta_p*r⁴/(8etaL) => Q/Q0=(r/r0)⁴. Same delta_p, viscosity, length, rigid circular tube, Newtonian steady fully-developed laminar regime. Square ratio twice. Actual5/4 fourth gives625/256. Manual2.44 has error9/15625, within0.5%; decimal approximation is qualified by consumer.
